description_text: Ents are a species of beings in J. R. R. Tolkien's fantasy world Middle-earth who closely resemble trees. They are similar to the talking trees in folklore around the world. Their name is derived from the Old English word for giant. Ents share some of the strengths and weaknesses of trees. Their skin is extraordinarily tough, and very much like wood; they can erode stone extremely rapidly, in the manner of tree roots, but they are vulnerable to fire and chopping blows from axes. Ents are an extremely patient and cautious race, with a sense of time more suited to trees than to short-lived mortals.  Ents are tall and very strong, capable of tearing apart rock and stone (though they use their full strength only when they are roused). Tolkien describes them as tossing great slabs of stone about, and ripping down the walls of Isengard like bread-crust

description_text:
Devil sticks vary widely in size and construction materials, but the batons are generally based on one of two basic designs: tapered and straight. Tapered batons are tapered from the ends towards the middle such that the middle is thinner than the ends. Straight batons are uniform in width but have weights attached to the ends. Rarely, a hybrid design consisting of a tapered baton with weights attached to the ends is used.
Illuminated devilsticks can create interesting visual effects in darkness with the use of battery-powered electric 'seed' bulbs; LEDs; or with phosphorescent or chemiluminescent materials.

description_text:
This is a low-poly model of a bound man in chains, kneeling on the ground in submission.
Software:Originally created with Blender 2.78c and rendered with Blender Cycles. Also available as a Unity package.
Specs:The .blend file includes 3 LOD versions of the statue, plus the high-poly sculpted meshes. The other files contain one LOD version each. The Unity package includes a stone material, textures and and a prefab with appropriate LOD management.LOD0:       Vertices: 8514       Faces: 16998 trisLOD1:       Vertices: 3442       Faces: 6853 trisLOD2:         Vertices: 1728       Faces: 3423 tris
Materials and Textures:The stone material is proceduraly generated using nodes in Cycles, using only a normal map and an ambiend occlusion map baked from the high-poly mesh. The results are baked into the textures used in Unity, including:Diffuse mapSpecular mapNormal mapOcclusion mapAll 4096X4096 in .png format.The textures are packed in the .blend file(only the normal and the ambiend occlusion map), in the Unity package and in the Textures.zip file(all 4 of them).
Usage:Best used for games/VR/AR or even movies in the background. In case of the Unity Engine, it's a simple drag and drop affair.
File formats:.blend.fbx.obj.dae.3ds.unitypackage

description_text:
This is a low-poly model of statue of a free man. His chains that held him captive lay broken and he has grown wings, like an angel.
Software:Originally created with Blender 2.79 and rendered with Blender Cycles (using Filmic color management). Also available as a Unity package.
Specs:The .blend file includes 3 LOD versions of the statue cut into separate pieces (for easier material creation) and 3 LOD versions as one object(using the baked textures for the separate pieces), plus the high-poly sculpted meshes. The other files contain one LOD version each. The Unity package includes a stone material, textures and and a prefab with appropriate LOD management.LOD0:       Vertices: 11349       Tris: 22666LOD1:       Vertices: 4549       Tris: 9066LOD2:       Vertices: 2962       Tris: 5889(all refer to the one-object versions of the statue)
Materials and Textures:The stone material is proceduraly generated using nodes in Cycles, using only a normal map and an ambiend occlusion map baked from the high-poly mesh. The results are baked into the textures used in Unity, including:Diffuse mapSpecular mapNormal mapAll 4096X4096 in .png format.The textures are packed in the .blend file(the necessary ones), in the Unity package and in the Textures.zip file.
Usage:Best used for games/VR/AR or even movies in the background. In case of the Unity Engine, it's a simple drag and drop affair.
File formats:.blend.fbx.obj.dae.3ds.unitypackage

description_text:
Game/VR/AR ready low-poly model of a Medieval Winged Spear with 2K PBR-textures built to real-world scale (metric system).
The medieval spear was one of the most formidable weapons of the age. Despite the prominence of swords in film and litterature, the spear was the primary infantery weapon in most medieval armies. Having long reach and requireing a small amount of steel made it both a powerful and economical weapon. The Winged Spear is 1.8 meters long and the 41 cm long head can be used for both cutting and stabbing. The two wings prevent opposing weapons from sliding down along the shaft, but can also be used to hook enemy weapons and shields.
The model and PBR-textures are prepared for use with Unity 5 and Unreal Engine 4, but can easily be adapted to other game engines, or to other uses. The model was created using Blender and Substance Painter. Preview images were rendered with Iray.
Polygon Count
1535 vertices
1184 faces
2220 triangles  
File Formats
Autodesk FBX (.fbx)*
OBJ (.obj)
Collada (.dae)
3D Studio (.3ds)
Blender (.blend)
* There are three different FBX-files, one standard PBR MetalRough, one for Unity and one for Unreal (the last two have triangulated faces).
Materials & Textures
The model is UV-mapped and has three different materials. Each material has three sets of physics based textures, one for PBR MetalRough, one for Unity 5 (metallic workflow) and one for Unreal Engine 4. The textures are not baked into the model, but are saved as png-files with a resolution of 2048 x 2048 pixels (8 bits) in the zip-file PBR textures and the subfolders PBR textures, Unity 5 textures and Unreal Engine 4 textures:

description_text:
The Little Man Atomic Bomb, dropped on the Japanese city of Hiroshima during World War 2 on 6 August 1945. Little Boy was the codename for the type of atomic bomb dropped on the Japanese city of Hiroshima on 6 August 1945 during World War II. It was the first nuclear weapon used in warfare. The bomb was dropped by the Boeing B-29 Superfortress Enola Gay piloted by Colonel Paul W. Tibbets, Jr., commander of the 509th Composite Group of the United States Army Air Forces. It exploded with an energy of approximately 15 kilotons of TNT (63 TJ) and caused widespread death and destruction throughout the city. The Hiroshima bombing was the second man-made nuclear explosion in history, after the Trinity test, and the first uranium-based detonation.

description_text:
Stylized Green Lantern Ring for 3dPrinting
This ring was made based on the ring used by the character Green Lantern.
Several individuals have assumed the name of Green Lantern over time. Each had a ring that gave them great control over the physical world. The ring was considered the most powerful weapon in the galaxy, creating complex shaped objects according to the mind of its bearer, limited only by two things: the Green Lantern willpower and the yellow color where the ring has no effect at all ( problem caused by an impurity in the original source that generated the rings). 
The Ring of the Green Lanterns must be recharged according to the rotation period of its carrier's home planet (on Earth, every 24 Hours). The battery of the ring resembled the old lantern used for example by the railwaymen to signal something on the rails to train drivers.
The rings of the Green Lanterns were made by the Guardians of the Universe, extremely ancient beings and powerful, who have the mission to watch over the maintenance of intergalactic peace. The power of the ring comes from the energy matter of the planet OA, home of the guardians, which is at the center of the universe, nourishing the vital energy of all beings in the universe.
Hope you like it!

description_text:
Game/VR/AR ready low-poly model of a medieval dagger with 4K PBR-textures built to real-world scale (metric system).
The dagger, in various shapes and forms, was a very common weapon during the middle ages. It was used for personal defense in civilian life since it was in most cases both legal and socially acceptable to carry. In war the dagger served as a backup to the main weapon for all types of solders, be it bowmen, crossbowmen, pikemen or men-at-arms. In addition it also served as a specialised weapon against armoured opponents where the narrow blade and point would be used to target less protected areas (for example armpits and between armour plates) of a men-at-arms and knights.
The model and PBR-textures are prepared for use with Unity 5 and Unreal Engine 4, but can easily be adapted to other game engines, or to other uses. The model was created using Blender and Substance Painter. Preview images were rendered with Iray.
Polygon Count
2093 vertices
2159 faces
4178 triangles  
File Formats
Autodesk FBX (.fbx)*
OBJ (.obj)
Collada (.dae)
Blender (.blend)
* There are three different FBX-files, one standard PBR MetalRough, one for Unity and one for Unreal (the last two have triangulated faces).
Materials & Textures
The model is UV-mapped and has a single material and three sets of physics based textures, one for PBR MetalRough, one for Unity 5 (metallic workflow) and one for Unreal Engine 4. The textures are not baked into the model, but are saved as png-files with a resolution of 4096 x 4096 pixels (8 bits) in the zip-file PBR textures in the subfolders PBR textures, Unity 5 textures and Unreal Engine 4 textures:
PBR textures
Medieval dagger_Dagger_Roughness.png
Medieval dagger_Dagger_AO.png
Medieval dagger_Dagger_BaseColor.png
Medieval dagger_Dagger_Metallic.png
Medieval dagger_Dagger_Normal.png  
Unity 5 textures
Medieval dagger_Unity_Dagger_AlbedoTransparency.png
Medieval dagger_Unity_Dagger_MetallicSmoothness.png
Medieval dagger_Unity_Dagger_Blade_Normal.png  
Unreal Engine 4 textures
Medieval dagger_Unreal_Dagger_BaseColor.png
Medieval dagger_Unreal_Dagger_Normal.png
Medieval dagger_Unreal_Dagger_OcclusionRoughnessMetallic.png

Their entire civilization invade planets, exterminating all indigenous life and harvesting the planet's natural resources. A single survivor of this race gathered survivors from the worlds targeted by the Harvesters and form a coalition to oppose them.
For thousands of years, the Harvesters have been at war against this coalition and continues to remain at a stalemate, as the Harvesters could not locate their enemies' planet of origin.
